decisions.allocation: Each verified119 base has1 evacuation-support kit and1 medical-support kit;4 kit slots total. Each base still has2 evacuation logical teams, so a spare team does not imply an extra kit. Cross-base dispatch is a real scarcity choice.
decisions.scope: One reusable training kit per logical operation regardless of rendered membercount; not actual center inventory/procurement or medical supply use
decisions.invariant: Stock+Committed+Consumed==Capacity; Consumed is used/outstanding reconditioning, TotalConsumed is per-run cumulative actual-use audit
decisions.reserve: After duplicate/request-id and compatible Ready team checks, reserve before committing logicaljob. FailedStartNext rolls back reservation; no false refund claim if rollback fails.
decisions.execution: Single owned Func<string,bool> OperationExecutionGate executes after actual interaction, BEFORE job.Released and TaskReady. Missing gate or false result holds owned work and cannot dispatch physical control. Unowned local ops unchanged. Same owned operation after first consume returns true without another decrement.
decisions.refund: Only actual Requested zero-distance predeparture job may refund; graph cancellation accepted first, then one refund. Same canceled request ID remains rejected.
decisions.restock: Only matching Replenishing mission with actual accepted countdown completed and total>=15 may restock, after replenished graph event. Used kit and unused carried reservation both return exactly one bounded slot. Duplicate restock adds nothing.
decisions.reset: New training run resets per-run authored allocation, reservation audit, outstanding/cumulative counters; kernel15..45seconds and countdown code unchanged
